lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high in early tests, but winning new_flow changes were consistently under-predicted.
sign_in hint and sign_in copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
choose_path layout and finish copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for home new_flow and home notification due to mixed results across 2 tests each.
Evidence is still thin for any kind of change tested only once.

candidates.title: Adoption Ceremony Experience Flow
candidates.change: Transform the adoption certificate step into an interactive ceremony experience where users sign their name with visual sparkles.
candidates.why: Adoption loses 28.2% of users with high mean duration (1017s). Making pet creation feel memorable increases emotional investment and completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Ceremony
adoption_certificate.body: Welcome your new companion into your digital home with an official signing ceremony.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.components[1]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Story Scroll Path Discovery Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the welcome story into a continuous story scroll layout that showcases paths visually as users scroll down.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s indicating hesitation. A story scroll layout seamlessly introduces choice cards.

story.headline: Begin Your Pet Companion Journey
story.body: Scroll to explore custom creations or adoption paths tailored to your desktop experience.

guard.reason: 'story.replace.intro_story[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the intro_story job (use ['animation', 'button', 'image', 'mascot', 'text', 'video'])

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Care Basics Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated onboarding screen demonstrating desktop controls, right-click menus, and pet interaction features before completing setup.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent emails under [after_onboarding, confusion] asking how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Let us quickly review how to interact with your pet on your screen.

new_care_basics.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_care_basics.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop to talk, feed, or hide them at any time.

guard.reason: Adding a care basics onboarding screen after home_intro is allowed and preserves all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen in finish step increases dropoff; prior test yielded -3.4%.

candidates.title: Deferred Sign In Path Reorder
candidates.change: Move the sign_in screen after pet creation screens (pick_friend and upload_photos), allowing users to pick or design their pet before authenticating.
candidates.why: sign_in early in the flow drops 27.1% of users. Allowing users to build affinity with their pet first increases sign-in motivation.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Companion
sign_in.body: Sign in now to sync your chosen companion to the cloud and ensure they are never lost.

guard.reason: Moving the sign-in step after pet creation is explicitly permitted and retains all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Deferring sign_in reduces high early dropoff (27.1%) by building pet affinity first.

candidates.title: Companion Stage Live Audio Waiting Room
candidates.change: Add an ambient sound player and stage loading animation on the waiting screen while pet generation processes in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s and support received bug reports of users thinking the app stalled during pet generation.

waiting.headline: Your Companion is Hatching...
waiting.body: Listen to gentle ambient sounds while your desktop pet is prepared for arrival.

guard.reason: Adding ambient audio and visual loading elements to the waiting screen keeps its core job of showing the pet being made.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long stall times and user confusion; new_flow changes tend to perform well.

candidates.title: Special Adoption Certificate Crest Incentive
candidates.change: Display a verified ownership crest badge on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops off 28.2%. Visual incentives like verified crests increase pride of completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Digital Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Complete adoption to receive your verified digital ownership crest.

guard.reason: Adding a verified companion crest badge maintains the official stamp requirement on the adoption certificate without violating pricing rules.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high dropoff (28.2%); visual incentives show positive trend.

candidates.title: Account Retrieval & Lost Pet Recovery Option
candidates.change: Add explicit account recovery guidance text on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to use their original sign-in method.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again with a secondary account.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Your Pet Account
sign_in.body: Sign in with your existing account to recover existing pets and prevent account resets.

components.text: Looking for a previously adopted pet? Make sure to use your original sign-in provider.

guard.reason: Adding sign-in recovery guidance text is allowed inside onboarding and does not violate any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets explicit support complaints regarding lost account access via simple config.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Companion Discovery Showcase
candidates.change: Switch the pet selection screen layout to full bleed, highlighting full artwork previews of available pets.
candidates.why: Pet adoption choice takes median 89s. Full bleed visual presentation makes selection faster and more engaging.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your Next Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Explore available pets in full visual resolution.

guard.reason: Updating the pet selection screen to a full-bleed layout preserves its function of letting the user pick a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption layout changes showed negative lift (-0.2%) in prior testing.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Verification Readiness Headline
candidates.change: Update waiting screen text to explicitly inform users that the pet will appear directly on their desktop screen once loading completes.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails reporting pets not appearing on desktop or users missing the initial spawn window.

waiting.headline: Preparing Companion Desktop Display
waiting.body: Ensure your desktop is visible. Your pet will spawn directly on your main monitor once loading finishes.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen text to clarify desktop appearance still conveys that the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak addressing minor support email issue, but copy changes have minimal impact.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Sound & Behavior Setup Screen
candidates.change: Add a pre-arrival behavior preferences screen where users configure initial pet sound effects and activity levels.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops 28.2% and mean time is 5815s. Giving users control over pet volume and behavior reduces post-onboarding confusion.

new_behavior_setup.headline: Pet Behavior & Interaction Setup
new_behavior_setup.body: Choose how active and vocal you want your pet to be on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a pet behavior setup screen before home_intro is permitted and maintains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding setup screens during finish increases friction on a 28.2% dropoff step.
